neglabel._source: NegLabel (Jiang et al., ICLR 2024): eta = 0.05, M = 10,000, n_g = 100 groups, sum-softmax score. Our choices (D1-D3, user-approved 2026-10-04 'NegLabel부터 해보자'): candidates = 50k MS MARCO passages (pool); ID label = known-source doc logit (top-10 mean, P6/P7); negative label = one passage (retriever native score); distance d_i = 5th percentile over known sources of -l_s(candidate); tau = P7 doc-only MSP tau of the (retriever, held-out source), grid reported; groups = seeded shuffle of the mined negatives; review: mining uses cosine (paper; matters only for contriever, whose raw dot product would favour low-norm passages), scores keep the retriever's native similarity
